title: KM VMS 0.8.4 — Maintenance Backup Safety and Diagnostic Archive UX
summary: Adds truthful and durable maintenance backup management, safe temporary restore validation, compact backup navigation and a consistent full diagnostic archive chooser.
changelog: Separates backup integrity, compatibility, freshness, availability and temporary restore-validation truth.
Makes backup create, check and delete operations durable, retryable and restart-reconcilable.
Rejects unsafe backup ownership, path and symlink conditions before reading or deleting artifacts.
Validates backups through an isolated temporary database restore and reports cleanup retry as pending instead of failed.
Uses one consistent backup snapshot in Maintenance, upgrade reports and support diagnostics.
Shows five compact backup rows per page with aligned metadata, icon actions, tooltips and arrow navigation.
Restores the standard or extended full diagnostic ZIP chooser across Maintenance and Audit entry points.
Keeps video archives outside database backup and restore claims.
